stem: How does the organization of paragraph 4 contribute to the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: It explains in sequential order the steps Mole took to create a living photograph.

options.label: B
options.text: It presents arguments to support the claim that Mole’s living photographs are a great accomplishment.

options.label: C
options.text: It compares the making of the picture of President Wilson with the way Mole made his other photographs.

options.label: D
options.text: It describes the problems people experienced while participating in Mole’s photographs and how Mole solved the problems.
